title: Methyl-C sequencing of single cell nuclei: snmC-seq2
author: Chongyuan Luo
license_note: Confirmed via CrossRef DOI metadata: dx.doi.org/10.17504/protocols.io.pjvdkn6

Random Primer solution 35µL random primer stock (100µM) in 7mL M-Elution buffer (500nM final primer concentration). Aliquot to eight 96-well plates. Random Priming Master Mix Combine 3600µL Blue Buffer (10x), 900µL Enzymatics Klenow exo- (50U/µL), 1800µL dNTP (10mM each), and 11700µL MB water in a 15mL tube and vortex to mix. Aliquot 180µL of master mix into each well of one 96-well plate. Keep sealed on ice until use. Do not store. Exo/rSAP Master Mix Combine 3600µL Exonuclease 1 (20U/µL) with 1800µL rSAP (1U/µL) in a 15mL tube and vortex to mix. Aliquot 53µL master mix to each well on one 96-well plate. Keep sealed on ice until use. Do not store. Adaptase Master Mix (using Accel-NGS® Adaptase™ Module) In a 15mL tube, to 1912.5µL M-Elution buffer, add 900µL Buffer G1, 900µL Reagent G2, 562.5µL Reagent G3, 225µL Enzyme G4, and 225µL Enzyme G5. Aliquot 295µL to 2 sets of 8-strip tubes (16 tubes total). Keep sealed on ice until use. Do not store. PCR Primer Mix Sequences of indexing primers with unique dual barcodes are provided in Supplementary Table 2. Each PCR Primer Mix contains a P5L indexing primer (600 nM) and a P7L indexing primer (1 µM). Procedure Bisulfite Conversion Timing ~ 5h 1. Add 15µL CT conversion reagent to each well of 384-well plate. Pipette up and down for 8 times to mix the sample. (Optional) This step can be automated using TECAN Freedom Evo 100 with script - 15uL_Conversion_Buffer 2. Seal the plate with adhesive film and quick spin for 10s at 2,000xg at room temperature. Place the plate in a thermocycler and run the following program: 98°C 8 min 64°C 3.5hrs

Timing ~2h 1. Denature the samples by placing 384-well PCR plate on a thermocycler and run the following program. 95°C 3 min Immediately place the plate on ice for 2 minutes. 2. Add 5µL Random Priming Master Mix to each well of the 384-well PCR plate. Vortex and quick spin for 10s at 2,000xg. (Optional) This step can be automated using TECAN Freedom Evo 100 with script - 5uL Random_Priming_Mix. 3. Place the plate in a thermocycler and run the following program: 4°C 5 min 25°C 5 min 37°C 60 min 4°C Hold Inactivation of free primers & dNTP 4. Add 1.5µL Exo/rSAP Master Mix to each well of the 384-well PCR plate. Vortex to mix the samples and quick spin for 10s at 2,000xg. (Optional) This step can be automated using TECAN Freedom Evo 100 with script - 1uL_Exo_rSAP_MM. 5. Place the plate in a thermocycler and run the following program 37°C 30 min 4°C Hold Sample clean-up 6. Add 73.6µL (0.8x) SPRI Beads to each well of four clean 96-well PCR plates. (Optional) This step can be automated using TECAN Freedom Evo 100 with script - BP_Add_To_Clean_96well.

7. Transfer samples from two 384-well plates to each 96-well plate. The eight quadrants (from two 384-well plates) barcoded with distinct indexed random primers are combined. Mix the samples by vortexing and incubate for 5 minutes at room temperature, then quick spin for 10s at 2,000xg. (Optional) This step can be automated using TECAN Freedom Evo 100 with script - BP_Transfer_Lib_384well_To_96well. 8. Place 96-well plates on DynaMag™-96 Side Magnet, let stand until solution in wells is clear of beads (~5 minutes). Remove supernatant and wash beads 3x with 150µL fresh 80% EtOH. Remove all EtOH, remove plates from magnet, and let beads dry at room temperature. DO NOT overdry beads. (Optional) This step can be automated using TECAN Freedom Evo 100 with script - BP_2Plate_150uL_EtOH_Wash. 9. Add 10µL EB buffer and resuspend beads by pipet. Vortex and incubate for 5 minutes at room temperature, then quick spin for 10s at 2,000xg. Place back on magnet and let stand until solution is clear of beads (~5 minutes). 10. Remove 10uL supernatant to a clean 96-well PCR plate. (Optional) This step can be automated using TECAN Freedom Evo 100 with script - 10ul_Pre_Adaptase_Transfer. Adaptase reaction 11. Denature the samples by placing 96-well plates on a thermocycler and run the following program. 95°C 3 min Immediately place the plate on ice for 2 minutes. 12. Add 10.5µL Adaptase Master Mix to each well of the 96-well PCR plate. Vortex and quick spin for 10s at 2,000xg. 13. Place the plate in a thermocycler and run the following program: 37°C 30 min 95°C 2 min

4°C Hold Library amplification 14. Add 5uL PCR Primer Mix. (Optional) This step can be automated using TECAN Freedom Evo 100 with script - 5uL_PCR_Primer. 15. Add 25µL 2x KAPA HiFi Mix. Vortex and quick spin for 10s at 2,000xg. 16. Place the plate in a thermocycler and run the following program: a. 95°C 2 min b. 98°C 30s c. 98°C 15s d. 64°C 30s e. 72°C 2 min Go to step c 14 times f. 72°C 5 min g. 4°C Hold Library clean-up 17. Sample cleanup. Add 40µL (0.8x) SPRI Beads to each well of four 96-well PCR plates. Transfer contents of one 96-well plate to another to combine four 96-well plates to two 96-well plates. Vortex and incubate for 5 minutes at room temperature, then quick spin for 10s at 2,000xg. (Optional) This step can be automated using TECAN Freedom Evo 100 with script - BP_Add_Beads_And_Combine_96well. 18. Place 96-well plates on DynaMag™-96 Side Magnet, let stand until solution in wells is clear of beads (~5 minutes). Remove supernatant and wash beads 2x with 150µL fresh 80% EtOH. Remove all EtOH, remove plate from magnet and let beads dry at room temperature. DO NOT overdry beads. (Optional) This step can be automated using TECAN Freedom Evo 100 with script - BP_2Plate_150uL_EtOH_Wash (stop script after two wash steps). 19. Add 25µL EB and resuspend beads by pipet. Vortex and incubate for 5 minutes at room temperature, then quick spin for 10s at 2,000xg. Place back on magnet

steps.title: Prepare 80% Ethanol
steps.instruction: Prepare 80% ethanol by adding 10µL MB water to 40mL of 200-proof Ethanol in a 50mL tube. Keep the solution sealed when not in use and prepare approximately 6 tubes fresh before each library preparation.

steps.title: Prepare Digestion Buffer Plates
steps.instruction: Prepare digestion buffer for FACS sorting of stained nuclei.

substeps.instruction: Combine 15mL M-Digestion Buffer with 14mL MB water in a 50mL tube; incubate for 10 minutes at 37°C to dissolve precipitate.
Resuspend one tube of Proteinase K with 1mL Proteinase K Resuspension Buffer and add 1mL of this to the digestion buffer mix.
Add 10µL λ DNA to the mix to aid determination of bisulfite conversion efficiency.
Vortex to mix.
Aliquot 2µL per well into 20 384-well plates (can be automated using TECAN Freedom Evo 100 with script '2uL_Digestion_Buffer').
Store plates at 4°C.

steps.title: Prepare Sera-Mag SPRI Beads
steps.instruction: Prepare a custom SPRI bead solution.

substeps.instruction: Mix Sera-Mag SpeedBeads and transfer 1mL to a 1.5ml tube.
Place beads on a magnetic stand until clear, remove supernatant, and wash beads twice with 1ml of TE (remove from magnet and mix by inversions for each wash).
Resuspend washed beads in 1ml of TE.
In a new 50ml sterile conical tube, combine 9g PEG 8000, 10ml 5M NaCl, 500µl 1M Tris-HCl (pH=8.0), and 100ul 0.5M EDTA (pH=8.0).
Mix until fully dissolved.
Add 1ml of the resuspended SpeedBeads to the 50ml tube and fill to volume with MB water.
Test the solution against AMPure XP beads using a 100bp DNA ladder.

steps.title: Prepare CT Conversion Reagent
steps.instruction: Prepare the CT Conversion Reagent by adding 7.9 mL M-Solubilization Buffer and 3 mL M-Dilution Buffer to a bottle of CT Conversion Reagent.

substeps.instruction: Shake vigorously at room temperature to fully dissolve.
Add 1.6 mL M-Reaction Buffer.

steps.title: Prepare M-Wash Buffer
steps.instruction: Add 288mL 200-proof Ethanol to four bottles of M-Wash buffer and invert to mix. Make fresh each time.

steps.title: Bind and Wash DNA
steps.instruction: Perform DNA binding and washing on a 384-Well DNA Binding Plate.

substeps.instruction: Load 80µL M-Binding buffer to each well of the plate (optional: TECAN script '80uL_Binding Buffer').

Transfer bisulfite conversion reactions to the Zymo-Spin 384 Well DNA Binding Plate, pipette up and down 8 times to mix, place on a 2.0mL 96-well Deep Well Plate, and centrifuge for 5 min at 5,000g. Decant flow through (optional: TECAN script '17uL_Conversion_Rxn_To_Binding_Buffer').
Add 100µL M-Wash Buffer to each well, centrifuge for 5 min at 5,000g, and decant flow through (optional: TECAN script '100uL_M_Wash_Buffer').
Add 50µL M-Desulphonation Buffer to each well, incubate at room temperature for 15 min, centrifuge for 5 min at 5,000g, and decant flow through (optional: TECAN script '50uL_Desulphonation_Buffer').
Add 100µL M-Wash Buffer to each well, centrifuge for 5 min at 5,000g, and decant flow through (optional: TECAN script '100uL_M_Wash_Buffer').
Repeat the previous M-Wash Buffer step once more.

steps.title: Elute and Barcode DNA
steps.instruction: Elute DNA using indexed random primers.

substeps.instruction: Place the 384-Well DNA Binding Plate on a new 384-well PCR plate.
Add 7µL Random Primer Solution to each well, ensuring each quadrant of the plate is barcoded with a distinct indexed random primer (optional: TECAN script '7uL_Primer_Elution').
Incubate for 5 min at room temperature.
Centrifuge for 5 min at 5,000g and discard the 384-Well DNA Binding Plate.
Seal the plate with adhesive film and store at -20°C for up to 1 week.

steps.title: First SPRI Bead Purification
steps.instruction: Perform initial bead cleanup of the synthesized DNA.

substeps.instruction: Remove 25uL supernatant to a clean 96-well PCR plate after letting the solution stand until clear of beads (~5 minutes).
Add 20µL (0.8x) SPRI Beads to each well of two 96-well PCR plates.

Combine the contents of the two 96-well plates into one 96-well plate, vortex, and incubate for 5 minutes at room temperature, then quick spin for 10s at 2,000xg (optional: TECAN script 'BP_Add_Beads_And_Combine_96well').
Place the plate on a DynaMag™-96 Side Magnet until clear (~5 minutes).
Remove supernatant and wash beads twice with 150µL fresh 80% EtOH (optional: TECAN script 'BP_1Plate_150uL_EtOH_Wash').
Remove all EtOH, remove plate from magnet, and let beads dry at room temperature (do not overdry).

steps.title: Elute and Pool Samples
steps.instruction: Elute the DNA and pool by column.

substeps.instruction: Add 20µL EB buffer and resuspend beads by pipet.
Vortex and incubate for 5 minutes at room temperature, then quick spin for 10s at 2,000xg.
Place on magnet until clear (~5 minutes).
Combine 20µL eluent from all 8 wells in each column (12 columns total) into 12 1.5µL Eppendorf tubes.
Add 128µL (0.8x) SPRI Beads to each 1.5µL Eppendorf tube, pipette to mix, and incubate for 5 minutes at room temperature.
Place tubes on a DynaMag™-2 Magnet until clear (~5 minutes).
Remove supernatant and wash beads twice with 200uL fresh 80% EtOH.
Remove all EtOH, remove tubes from magnet, and let beads dry at room temperature (do not overdry).
Add 40µL EB and resuspend beads by pipet.
Incubate for 5 minutes at room temperature, then place back on magnet until clear (~5 minutes).
Remove 40uL supernatant to 12 clean 1.5µL Eppendorf tubes.
Measure concentration of each tube using Qubit dsDNA BR Assay Kit, normalize library concentrations, and pool for sequencing.
